name: Tormus Deepforge

angles.text: Muren Stormpike sends promising warriors to Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge. There, they prove their mettle and seek a weapon forged for their calling.
Ironforge's master smiths test promising Alliance fighters with dangerous undertakings before they forge fine weapons for them.

faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge is an accomplished weaponsmith in Ironforge. He can forge exceptional weapons for warriors who prove their courage and ability through dangerous deeds.
Muren Stormpike sends promising fighters to Tormus Deepforge when they are ready for a weapon suited to their growing martial skill.
faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Tormus Deepforge?

faq.answer: Tormus agrees to forge a fine weapon after the adventurer does him a favor. He asks for a perilous undertaking that could mean death, the kind of challenge he believes an aspiring warrior seeks.
faq.q: What does Tormus Deepforge ask in return for making a weapon?

faq.answer: Tormus warns that the undertaking is perilous because it could cost a life. He believes danger is the proper test for anyone worthy of his craft.
faq.q: Why does Tormus emphasize that the job is dangerous?

faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge works near the Great Forge in Ironforge. Fellow smiths, anvils, and roaring smelters surround him.
faq.q: Where can Tormus Deepforge be found?

faq.answer: Tormus works with warriors sent by their trainers. He seeks fighters with the grit and resolve to face life-threatening dangers.
faq.q: Which adventurers does Tormus Deepforge work with?

sections.body: Tormus Deepforge is a master dwarven weaponsmith in Ironforge. Warriors who show their growing skill to Muren Stormpike are sent across the city to consult him. Tormus is known for sturdy, potent arms, but he does not give fine blades or bludgeons to every passerby. A warrior must earn his work through action.
sections.title: The Blacksmith's Anvil

sections.body: Before Tormus agrees to forge a weapon, he asks the adventurer to promise him a favor. He speaks plainly about the danger ahead and warns that it could cost a life. To him, peril is no reason to turn back. It is the proper test of a warrior's mettle.
sections.title: A Perilous Trial

summary: In Ironforge, Tormus Deepforge waits for fighters sent by Muren Stormpike. Before he forges a weapon for them, he asks them to face a perilous trial.
